projects.name: Marrea Apps
projects.description: ERP system built for one of the largest real estate and construction companies in Bayugan City.
projects.details:
Marrea Apps turns the company's manual, paper and spreadsheet processes into a single custom system. It covers accounting (payment requests, billing, collections), sales and accounts, unit management, inventory, purchasing and HR, and supports construction and equipment operations. Dashboards and reports give each department a live view of its own numbers.

I lead a small team of developers and have worked across every module, from sales and units to inventory, accounting and HR. I oversee the whole development process: architecture, code review, server management and deployment.

projects.name: Playmevo
projects.description: Working prototype of a gaming platform built for a foreign client, with fully custom games.
projects.details:
Playmevo is a gaming platform where players can play, deposit and cash out currency. It has a game lobby, fully implemented custom games such as Plinko with switchable themes, a player wallet, and an admin panel for managing players, balances and games.

Security was a core requirement. Everything runs through one central wallet, and every bet, win and refund is an idempotent transaction, so a retried game provider callback never credits a balance twice. Balance changes are atomic database transactions, game outcomes are decided on the server rather than the client, and every request is authenticated and validated before it touches the wallet.

This project uses mock data and no actual money is involved.

projects.name: POS and Inventory System
projects.description: POS and inventory system I built for a local business in Panabo City.
projects.details:
I built this for a local business in Panabo City that has more than one branch. Cashiers use it to ring up sales, print receipts, and handle returns and replacements.

The back office tracks stock per branch, orders from suppliers, and moves stock between branches. Every stock change is logged. The owner can see sales by branch and print sales, inventory and financial reports.
